sections.heading: Your first expedition
sections.body: Lumo Ruins is your first normal combat area. Equip your starter kit and accessories, then start its battle from Shenic. Combat continues as an ongoing action.

sections.heading: Win an encounter
sections.body: Into the Ruins requires a victory in Lumo Ruins. Starting the action alone does not complete the objective. Return to Combat to inspect encounters and rewards, and follow the journal when the victory is recorded.

sections.heading: Equipment from victories
sections.body: Equipment & Forge shows your available equipment targets and progress. Select a plain equipment target when you need another piece; victories advance its displayed counter. The target pauses after its award. Your combat rewards do not require gathering tools.
